meta.note: PSNR curve: optimization-based inversion baseline fit to Geiping et al. ResNet-18/ImageNet results. DP utility: CIFAR-10 DP-SGD benchmarks from Abadi et al. 2016, extrapolated to larger models.

psnrModel.note: basePsnr(B) = max(floor, intercept - slope * log2(B)), fit to optimization-based inversion curve

dpLevels.label: ε = 8
dpLevels.note: Weak DP — common in enterprise FL. Protects against passive observers, not determined adversaries.

dpLevels.label: ε = 4
dpLevels.note: Moderate DP. Reconstruction degrades noticeably but model utility falls to ~60% of non-private baseline.

dpLevels.label: ε = 1
dpLevels.note: Strong DP. Reconstruction is in the private zone, but only ~20% model utility survives — not viable for most tasks.

dpLevels.label: ε = 0.1
dpLevels.note: Very strong DP. Reconstruction impossible, but the model is essentially random noise — completely unusable.
